enable_debug.description: Enable verbose debugging logs for troubleshooting.

log_file.description: Path to log file (empty = logs to stdout).

bind_all_interfaces.description: Bind services to all network interfaces (true) or localhost only (false).

local_address.description: Local IP address to bind services to (ignored if bind_all_interfaces=true).

exchange_url.description: Full URL to Microsoft Exchange EWS endpoint (e.g., https://outlook.office365.com/EWS/Exchange.asmx).

password.description: Exchange password (not recommended; prefer OAuth2 or leave blank for secure prompt).

oauth2_enabled.description: Enable OAuth2 authentication with Microsoft Entra ID.

oauth2_client_id.description: OAuth2 client ID registered in Microsoft Entra.

oauth2_tenant_id.description: OAuth2 tenant ID (directory ID) for Microsoft Entra.

keystore_path.description: Path to Java keystore (for HTTPS admin UI).

keystore_password.description: Keystore password (required if keystore_path is set).

trust_all_certs.description: Trust all SSL certificates (not recommended for production).

imap_show_deleted.description: Show deleted messages in IMAP Trash folder.

imap_keep_drafts.description: Keep draft messages on server after sending.

ldap_base_dn.description: LDAP base DN for user/group searches.

ldap_bind_dn.description: LDAP bind DN for authenticated searches (optional).

ldap_server_url.description: LDAP server URL (e.g., ldap://ldap.example.com) — leave blank to use local DavMail LDAP proxy.

caldav_default_calendar.description: Default calendar name for CalDAV clients.

jvm_args.description: List of JVM arguments to pass to DavMail (e.g., ['-Xmx1024m', '-Duser.timezone=UTC']).
